source: A real WHOOP 5.0/MG METADATA HISTORY_END frame captured from hardware (imported from tanarchytan/whoop-rs, where it pins the same decode): kind 2, seq 145, record unix 1784236473 at inner 3, and the 8-byte end_data (trim cursor 113405, next 16) at inner 13..21. The acknowledgement must echo exactly those eight bytes — the strap re-serves the same chunk forever otherwise — so ack_payload is the end_data slice, not the whole body: the body's leading bytes are the record unix and counters, and echoing them would hand the strap a garbage cursor.

produced_with.generator: real hardware capture (whoop-rs), CRCs verified on import
